rationale: The agent verified the user by matching full name and zip to a single account, then used tools to fetch accurate order details. It correctly identified the Chicago order (#W7895761), provided the shipped-to address, tracking number, and status (delivered), and answered the tablet storage question (64GB) from the item options. Before changing the default shipping address, the agent clearly stated the change, obtained explicit confirmation, executed the update via the tool, and confirmed success. No unsupported claims, no actions on the wrong account, and no writes without confirmation. The casual chat was appropriate and did not conflict with policy.
